# Setup {.unnumbered}

What readers install before Chapter 1.

1. **R** — <https://cran.r-project.org/>
2. **An editor** — RStudio or Positron
3. **Quarto** — <https://quarto.org/> (bundled with recent RStudio)
4. **Packages**

```{r}
#| eval: false
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "tidymodels"))
```
